Messages.Author: kula...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
Does the tempted vampire return to his original controller if the
temptation burns before the end of my turn? It's a card driven effect,
but if the card is no longer there would the effect still last? Was
wondering if the Martinelli's ring could be used that way.

Maybe it's like the bomb... I take a (D) action to burn a location,
and was blocked. The bomb is burnted in combat somehow, and then I
form of mist. The action continues but fails since the bomb is no
longer there... The effect fizzles.

I'm pretty sure it's going to be still returned to the OG controller,
but it's worth asking. It'll be evil if it did work that way...

Temptation
Type: Action
Requires: Serpentis
Cost: 1 blood
[ser] (D) Put this card on a ready vampire; you still control this
card. During your master phase, you may put a counter on this card.
During your minion phase, if the number of counters on this card equals
or exceeds the amount of blood on that vampire, you may burn all the
counters on this card to untap that vampire and take control of him or
her until the end of your turn.
[SER] As above, but put a counter on this card when you put it on the
vampire.

Martinelli's Ring
Type: Equipment
Unique equipment.
Cards that require Malkavian, Malkavian antitribu, Dementation [dem] or
Serpentis [ser] cannot target or be placed on this minion. Burn any
cards on this minion that require any of those clans or Disciplines.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
kulaid...@gmail.com wrote:
> Does the tempted vampire return to his original controller if the
> temptation burns before the end of my turn?

Yes. "Until the end of your turn".

See also Camarilla Vitae Slave rulings.

> It's a card driven effect,
> but if the card is no longer there would the effect still last?

This is moot, but the alternative would be to lose the control granted
by Temptation when Temptation is burned, not to keep that control
forever.
